title: Nine times out of ten it's not the algorithm, its something else.
description: Nine times out of ten it's not the algorithm, its something else.
transcript: What is the number one reason that meta ads fail? The number one reasons meta ads fail is because the offer is not good enough. And what I mean by that specifically is people don't wanna buy your thing at the price of which you're offering it. I've had so many conversations with people that are running meta ads and going, oh, my ads aren't selling, and I'm like, hang on, give me two seconds. And then you just jump on Amazon and you search for their product and you're like, here's your product, 20% cheaper next day delivery. That's why it's not working. you have to have something differentiated. They're like, oh, okay. It's like, yeah, build a brand or invent something genuinely unique or only advertise locally and dominate that market. Like, you have to have a differential, otherwise, like, it's not gonna work.
